title: Holiday allowance
question: How many paid holiday days do full-time employees receive?
answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid holiday per year, in addition to public holidays, as stated in the "Northwind Robotics Employee Handbook" (handbook.txt).

title: Product warranty
question: What is the warranty period for a Northwind Robotics unit?
answer: The warranty period for a Northwind Robotics unit is 24 months, covering manufacturing defects, as stated in the Northwind Robotics Product FAQ (Source 1: product-faq.txt).

sources.snippet:
Northwind Robotics Product FAQ

What is the warranty period?
All robotics units carry a 24 month warranty covering manufacturing defects.
